title: Tunisian Tagine Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with mung beans and luxuriant vegetables, cooked to perfection in a traditional Tunisian tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the mung beans, luxuriant sprouts, and bean sprouts. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes or until the mung beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional luxuriant sprouts if desired.
